evals.title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
evals.steal: Do not use this as the companion score. It is two-speaker friend-chat fact QA.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Vendor default. Winning it does not select identity, silence, or poisoning.

evals.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
evals.steal: Abstention and knowledge-update exist. They are still probe-at-end assistant QA.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Chat-assistant haystack. Vendor 94% claims are not this paper.

evals.title: LongMemEval-V2
evals.steal: Latency as a first-class score. Domain is web and enterprise workflow, not a companion.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Not an upgraded LoCoMo. Web-agent experience.

evals.title: PersonaMem-v2: Implicit Personalization in Long-Form Human-AI Interaction
evals.steal: ask_to_forget, hypothetical vs self, implicit prefs. Closest public user-modeling bench.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Tool-chatbot, not a character. Still the closest hole 3 and 9 coverage.

evals.title: BEAM: Benchmarking Episodic and Associative Memory
evals.steal: Ability list plus million-token buckets. Still user-assistant probes.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Scale is the point. Companion identity is absent.

evals.title: Locomo-Plus
evals.steal: Constraint consistency under cue-trigger disconnect. Closest public proxy for social timing.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Same LoCoMo chats plus cognitive cues. Not trauma, kink, or spoilers.

evals.title: PrefEval
evals.steal: A preference that a generic answer would violate. Preference following, not identity.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Personalized chatbot under LMSYS distractors.

evals.title: Multi-Session Chat
evals.steal: Explicit between-session time skip. Hours or days, not three months.
evals.why_band: Slice F. Five-session friend chat and next-utterance perplexity.

evals.title: HaluMem: Evaluating Hallucinations in Memory Systems of Agents
evals.steal: Score write and retrieve operations, not only the final spoken answer. Fabrication and conflict at the store.
evals.why_band: Closest public bench to hole 7. Operation-level hallucination, not persona overwrite by a planted jailbreak.

evals.title: Evaluating Memory Structure in LLM Agents
evals.steal: Score how the store is organized, not only whether a fact comes back. MemoryLACE used this.
evals.why_band: Could be used to select a companion store's types. Still an agent-memory structure bench, not RP identity.

evals.title: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions
evals.steal: Selective forgetting and incremental multi-turn updates. Still agent tasks, not a companion.
evals.why_band: ICLR 2026 MemoryAgentBench. Commonly cited as the memory-agent eval. Selective forgetting is hole 9 adjacent.

evals.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
evals.steal: Correct retrieval can still be the wrong use. Traps after the store is right.
evals.why_band: Attacks retrieve-equals-remember. Traps are not typed retcon or persona overwrite.

evals.title: PerLTQA: A Personal Long-Term Memory Dataset for Memory Classification, Retrieval, and Synthesis
evals.steal: Semantic versus episodic as named classes. Social relationships as a memory kind.
evals.why_band: Closest public ontology among QA evals. Thirty characters. Still retrieve-then-answer.

evals.title: DialSim: A Dialogue Simulator for Evaluating Long-Term Multi-Party Dialogue Understanding
evals.steal: TV-show character roleplay with a time budget. Latency is part of the score.
evals.why_band: RP plus long-term multi-party. Session-scale TV canon, not months of one companion.

evals.title: RP-Bench: Roleplay Quality Benchmark for LLMs
evals.steal: Lorebook integration, 50-turn memory, card follow, agency, time tracking. Closest public RP continuity suite.
evals.why_band: Could be mistaken for a companion memory eval. It scores the model plus prompt, not a typed store across months.

evals.title: CharacterEval: A Chinese Benchmark for Role-Playing Conversational Agent Evaluation
evals.steal: Thirteen RP metrics including personality consistency. Session-scale Chinese RP.
evals.why_band: Identity fidelity without a long-term memory store. Will be cited as if it selected companion memory.

evals.title: InCharacter: Evaluating Personality Fidelity in Role-Playing Agents through Psychological Interviews
evals.steal: Interview the character on psychological scales instead of asking it to recite lore.
evals.why_band: Personality fidelity, 32 characters, 14 scales. No store. No 50-session drift.

evals.title: When Users Don't Ask: Benchmarking Context-Driven Memory Retrieval in Conversational Agents
evals.steal: Score in-situ use when the user never asks a memory probe. Direct QA is the wrong task.
evals.why_band: Closest public attack on hole 2's QA-probe setup. Still assistant conversation, not trauma silence.

evals.title: MemUse: Moving Memory Evaluation from Direct QA to Natural Integration
evals.steal: Direct QA accuracy and user satisfaction can diverge. Do not treat F1 as the companion score.
evals.why_band: Measured evidence that LoCoMo-class scores are the wrong rubric. Human-AI conversation, not RP identity.

evals.title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks
evals.steal: LoCoMo-saturated agents fail when memory must drive later actions. Recall benches do not predict use.
evals.why_band: ICML 2026. Agent execution, not a companion. The negative result on recall benches is the steal.

evals.title: PRAGMA: Evaluating Personalized Guidance with Memory Alignment in Lifelong Conversations
evals.steal: Personalized guidance over lifelong chat. Alignment of memory with advice, not pointwise recall.
evals.why_band: Newest personalized-assistant eval (2026-09-09). Guidance, not companion identity or lore.

evals.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict
evals.steal: Some conflicts have no gold fact. Forcing one winner is the bug. Ask, hold, or qualify.
evals.why_band: Closest public item to hole 4's 'no single writer wins'. Still personal-assistant prefs, not user vs character vs narrator.

evals.title: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory
evals.steal: Score whether retrieved evidence is used, not whether a pointwise fact is recovered.
evals.why_band: Attacks pointwise recall. Still conversational memory QA, not companion identity.

evals.title: Reconstructing the Right Episode: Evaluating Interleaved Conversational Memory Beyond Long Context
evals.steal: Interleaved topics in one thread. Session boundaries in other benches leak the answer.
evals.why_band: Chat-assistant episode reconstruction. Not RP, not poisoning.

evals.title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents
evals.steal: Write policy as a four-way choice. Persist, use once, re-verify, or ask. Do not always store.
evals.why_band: Memory-clarification boundary. Agent write policy, not companion retcon writers.

evals.title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
evals.steal: Table 1 map of in-episode versus cross-episode knowledge versus execution. Use it as a landscape, not a companion score.
evals.why_band: Agent self-evolving memory. Knowledge plus execution. Not a companion.

evals.title: Evo-Memory: Benchmarking LLM Agent Test-time Learning with Self-Evolving Memory
evals.steal: Sequential task streams. Memory must evolve after each interaction. Independent tasks, not one relationship.
evals.why_band: Test-time learning. MemoryArena notes the tasks are independent, so not interdependent sessions.

evals.title: MemoryBench
evals.steal: Continual learning from simulated feedback. Confirm openness before citing as a bakeoff.
evals.why_band: EvoMemBench says it is not fully open. Agent continual learning, not companion.

evals.title: StuLife: Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Benchmark
evals.steal: Proactive initiative over a simulated college life. Persistent state across phases. GPT-5 17.9/100 in the paper.
evals.why_band: Lifelong student agent. Time and initiative. Not a companion character.

evals.title: PingPong: A Benchmark for Role-Playing Language Models with User Emulation
evals.steal: User-simulator plus multi-model judges. Session RP quality, not a memory store.
evals.why_band: Roleplay dialogue quality. Adjacent to hole 1 only as session identity, not 50-session drift.

evals.title: Boson RPBench / RPBench-Auto
evals.steal: Character-based versus scene-based RP. 5 to 10 turns. Side-by-side with a baseline model.
evals.why_band: Session RP chatbot eval. Not a long-term store. Blog primary, not a paper we card.

evals.title: SOTOPIA: Interactive Evaluation for Social Intelligence
evals.steal: Goal-driven social interaction between agents. Social intelligence, not stored relationship memory.
evals.why_band: Social sim. No companion memory store. Do not cargo-cult as LTM.

evals.title: PersonaGym: Evaluating Persona Agents
evals.steal: Dynamic questions from situation plus persona. Persona fidelity, not months of chat.
evals.why_band: Persona agent eval. No typed memory kinds.

evals.title: MemoryBank SiliconFriend 194 probes
evals.steal: 194 bilingual probes on a companion-shaped chatbot. Already scored on the memorybank product card.
evals.why_band: Not a public bakeoff harness. Lives inside the MemoryBank paper. Do not double-card.

evals.title: MemoryLake on MemoryArena: A Matched Study of Agent Memory Backends
evals.steal: Matched backends on MemoryArena. Vector RAG and long-context can beat complex stores on action tasks.
evals.why_band: Study of backends, not a new companion eval. Use MemoryArena's card.

evals.title: Live-Evo: Online Evolution of Agentic Memory from Continuous Feedback
evals.steal: Online memory evolution from feedback. Agent skill memory, not relationship state.
evals.why_band: Self-evolving agent memory method. Not a companion bench.

evals.title: Graph-Based Personalized Memory
evals.steal: Graph personalization as an eval setting. Still retrieve-then-speak unless the paper says otherwise.
evals.why_band: Fresh graph-memory eval. Not RP. Confirm methods before promoting.

evals.title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
evals.steal: Do not treat context-window needles as companion memory.
evals.why_band: Long-context synthetic retrieval. Not a memory system, not a companion.

evals.title: Needle In A Haystack
evals.steal: A context-window smoke test. Not relationship memory.
evals.why_band: NIAH. Long-context retrieval of a planted sentence.

evals.title: BABILong
evals.steal: Facts buried in noise. Long-context reasoning, not companions.
evals.why_band: bAbI facts in long haystacks. Context length, not LTM stores.

evals.title: InfiniteBench
evals.steal: 100k+ token tasks. Window size, not a companion store.
evals.why_band: Long-context benchmark suite.

evals.title: LongBench
evals.steal: Bilingual long-context QA and summarization. Not LTM.
evals.why_band: Long-context bilingual bench.

evals.title: LaMP / LongLaMP personalization
evals.steal: Personalization from user histories in classification and generation. Not a companion.
evals.why_band: Personalized NLP tasks. Not interactive memory over months of RP.

evals.title: ALFWorld / WebArena / AgentBench
evals.steal: Do not score companion memory on web or household agents.
evals.why_band: Agent execution harnesses. Memory is incidental.

evals.title: MEMOBench robot process memory
evals.steal: Robot process memory is a different domain.
evals.why_band: Robotics. Wrong ontology.

evals.title: GMSBench GPU memory safety
evals.steal: The word memory here is GPU RAM.
evals.why_band: GPU safety. Name collision.

evals.title: ECCBench VLM
evals.steal: Vision-language, not companion LTM.
evals.why_band: VLM bench. Name collision with memory.

evals.title: MemToC tool versus parametric memory
evals.steal: Tool versus weights. Not a companion store.
evals.why_band: Parametric versus tool memory for agents.

evals.title: DreamBench-SWE coding-agent hygiene
evals.steal: Coding-agent memory hygiene. Negative control, like claude-mem.
evals.why_band: Software engineering agents.

evals.title: R2M-Bench video worlds
evals.steal: Video-world memory. Wrong modality.
evals.why_band: Video worlds, not text companions.

evals.title: DualEval: Joint Model-Item Calibration for Unified LLM Evaluation
evals.steal: IRT over static plus arena scores. A ranking method, not a memory bench.
evals.why_band: Meta-eval calibration. Not companion memory.
